story.x: As standard, a Safety Net comes fitted on every GPX, one per tool.Now that we've reached the stretch goal, we're adding one spare Safety Net for every backer as a thank-you.
story.z: 作为标准配置，每个GPX都配备一个安全网，每个工具配备一个安全网。现在，我们已经达到了延伸目标，我们将为每个支持者添加一个备用安全网，以表示感谢。

story.x: Introducing AirCannon GPX: a handheld blower that hits 118mph(190km/h), squeezed into the most compact body in its class. Maximum power, minimum size: one hand is all it takes to clear your path. Gale-Force Power, Times X. The AirCannon is back, now as the GPX series.
story.z: 隆重推出AirCannon GPX ：这款手持式鼓风机时速可达118英里（ 190公里/小时） ，是同类产品中最紧凑的机身。最大功率，最小尺寸：只需一只手即可清除路径。Gale-Force Power ， Times X。AirCannon又回来了，现在是GPX系列。

story.x: A legend didn’t just burst onto the scene, it practically blew the doors off Kickstarter. The original AirCannon became #1 because it was the powerful, portable beast you knew you needed, but could never find. The legend has hit the gym. Hard.
story.z: 一个传奇人物不仅突然出现在现场，而且几乎炸开了Kickstarter的大门。最初的AirCannon之所以成为第一，是因为它是您知道自己需要但永远找不到的强大便携式野兽。传说已经击中了健身房。很难。

story.x: How do you hold a Category 3 hurricane in the your hand? Simple: 140,000 RPM. This isn’t a marketing puff piece; it’s raw physics... We’re not exaggerating; we're just engineered better.
story.z: 您如何握住手中的3级飓风？简单： 140,000 RPM。这不是营销泡芙，而是原始物理……我们没有夸大其词，我们只是设计得更好。

story.x: GPX pushes with 2.4lb(1.1kg) of force. That is a dumbbell's worth of weight, lifted by nothing but air. Point it at a full tank of water. Gone in an instant.
story.z: GPX以2.4磅（ 1.1千克）的力推动。这是一个哑铃的重量，只有空气才能举起。将它指向装满水的水箱。瞬间消失了。

story.x: You love comparing CFM, right? Let’s play. Your average, clunky backyard leaf blower kicks out around 230–250 CFM. Now, The GPX. At just 7.8 inches (198mm) long, it generates a comparable 237 CFM. We ditched the bulk but kept the grunt.
story.z: 您喜欢比较CFM ，对吧？让我们来玩吧。您的平均笨重的后院吹叶机在230–250 CFM左右踢出。现在， GPX。它只有7.8英寸（ 198毫米）长，可产生可比的237 CFM。我们扔掉了大块头，但保持了咕噜声。

story.x: For stronger, more precise airflow, GPX is built on aviation motor technology: high output for liftoff, sustained efficiency for long flights, and bulletproof durability in extreme conditions. All three, now packed into one tool with Jet-Force Wind.
story.z: 为了获得更强劲、更精确的气流， GPX基于航空发动机技术：高输出升空，长途飞行的持续效率，以及极端条件下的防弹耐用性。所有三个，现在都与Jet-Force Wind集成在一个工具中。

story.x: GPX's blade is forged from zinc-aluminum alloy, hard enough to slice through the air instead of pushing it. That is where the sharp, focused airflow comes from. Corrosion-resistant, heat-resistant, high-strength: it won't bend, and it won't break.
story.z: GPX的刀片由锌铝合金锻造而成，足够硬，可以在空气中切割而不是推压。这就是尖锐、集中的气流的来源。耐腐蚀、耐热、高强度：不会弯曲，也不会断裂。

story.x: Unwavering Power. Power that fades in seconds is strictly for amateurs. GPX uses high-thermal-conductivity alloy to dissipate heat the moment it builds, keeping temperature stable throughout.
story.z: 坚定不移的力量，在几秒钟内消失的力量，严格适用于业余爱好者。GPX使用高导热合金在建造时散热，保持整个温度稳定。

story.x: The ESC (Electronic Speed Controller) regulates high voltage and current with precision, preventing overload during extended use. Max power for a full 30 seconds is not a lucky streak. It is engineered.
story.z: ESC （电子速度控制器）精确调节高电压和电流，防止长时间使用时的过载。整整30秒的最大能量不是一个幸运的连胜。它是经过精心设计的。

story.x: The science behind the storm: the Triple Vane System. Three layers work as one. A 6-vane stator and a 5-vane stator flank the blade on both sides, and their staggered vanes converge incoming air into a single, focused Dual-Helix stream with no dispersion and no waste. The blade then drives that stream forward with force: over 2x the output of a single-rotor design, enough to clear leaves and standing water in one pass.
story.z: 风暴背后的科学：三叶片系统。三层合为一体。一个6叶片定子和一个5叶片定子在叶片的两侧侧面，它们的交错叶片将进入的空气汇聚成一个单一的、聚焦的双螺旋流，没有分散和浪费。然后，叶片用力向前推动水流：超过单转子设计输出的2倍，足以一次清除树叶和积水。

story.x: Lighter than comparable blowers
story.z: 比同类风机更轻

story.x: Weighing in at a 0.77lbs (0.35kg), GPX is 43% lighter than the bulky alternatives. Carry it all day, clean the whole yard, and your arm won't even notice. Zero wrist drag.
story.z: GPX的重量为0.77磅（ 0.35千克） ，比笨重的替代品轻43%。整天拿着它，打扫整个院子，你的手臂甚至都不会注意到。零手腕阻力。

story.x: Blast it. Pinpoint it. Vacuum it.
story.z: 爆破它，精确定位它，用吸尘器吸尘。

story.x: Three nozzles, three jobs, all included. Each one reshapes GPX's airflow with serious aerodynamics, squeezing even more power out of that 118mph engine.
story.z: 三个喷嘴，三个作业，全部包括在内。每一个都通过严重的空气动力学重塑GPX的气流，从118英里/小时的发动机中挤出更多的动力。

story.x: With the Boost Nozzle on, you get 25% more power, enough to leave your pickup spotless and blow off every drop in seconds, scratch-free. Tired of towel-drying by hand because your old blower can't keep up? GPX has the muscle to keep your ride looking flawless.
story.z: 开启Boost喷嘴后，您将获得25%的动力，足以让您的拾音器一尘不染，并在几秒钟内吹掉每一滴，无划痕。厌倦了用手晾晒毛巾，因为您的旧鼓风机跟不上？ GPX拥有强大的肌肉，让您的骑行看起来完美无瑕。

story.x: The Detail Nozzle hides a secret: a bullet-shaped centerbody narrows the airflow channel, accelerating the air and creating a pressure differential that pulls it toward the center. Cross-section narrowed by 66%. Fired like an arrow. Hits like a critical hit.
story.z: 细节喷嘴隐藏了一个秘密：子弹形状的中心体缩小了气流通道，加速了空气，并产生了向中心拉动的压差。横截面缩小了66%。像箭一样射出。像暴击一样命中。

story.x: Your PC works hard under a layer of dust while you're hunting for a new AI model. Give your workhorse the cleanup it's earned. The Detail Nozzle's pinpoint airflow reaches every corner, bringing your rig back to factory-fresh. Aim. Fire.
story.z: 当您在寻找新的人工智能模型时，您的电脑会在一层灰尘下努力工作。为你的主力提供所赚的清理费。Detail喷嘴的精确气流可到达每个角落，使您的钻机恢复出厂状态。瞄准。开火。

story.x: GPX doesn't just push air. It pulls it in, and like a real hurricane, it pulls you in when you get too close. The Vacuum Nozzle draws in dust at up to 12,000Pa of suction pressure.
story.z: GPX不仅仅是推动空气。它会把它拉进来，就像真正的飓风一样，当你靠得太近时，它会把你拉进来。真空喷嘴在高达12,000Pa的吸入压力下吸入灰尘。

story.x: Inside the Vacuum Nozzle: a HEPA filter that traps 99.97% of particles down to 0.3 microns. From large debris to fine dust, it's sucked in and locked in. Keep your space spotless.
story.z: 真空喷嘴内部：一种HEPA过滤器，可捕获99.97%的颗粒，直至0.3微米。从大块碎屑到细小的灰尘，都被吸入并锁定。保持房源一尘不染。

story.x: Most blowers make you flip the entire unit around, grip and all, just to switch to suction. GPX solves it with instant reverse rotation: one button reverses the motor and you're in suction mode.
story.z: 大多数鼓风机都会让您翻转整个装置、抓地力和所有东西，只是为了切换到吸力。GPX通过即时反向旋转解决了这个问题：一个按钮反转电机，您就处于吸入模式。

story.x: Switch from Suction Mode to Blower Mode in 1 second. Blast out everything trapped inside.
story.z: 在1秒钟内从吸入模式切换到鼓风机模式。炸掉被困在里面的一切。

story.x: Use it to clean dust inside your car. Need to empty it? Open the lid, flip to Blower Mode, and fire. The hurricane clears itself out. No removing the dust cup, no shaking it out.
story.z: 用它来清洁车内的灰尘。需要清空吗？打开盖子，翻转到鼓风机模式，然后开火。飓风自行清除。无需拆卸防尘杯，也无需抖动防尘杯。

story.x: To maximize runtime, GPX runs on a battery rated up to 5,000 mAh, a full 120 minutes of nonstop power. Drying a full-size SUV takes about 20 minutes. One charge, six cars.
story.z: 为了最大限度地延长运行时间， GPX在额定电量高达5,000 mAh的电池上运行，整整120分钟的不间断电源。烘干全尺寸SUV大约需要20分钟。一次充电，六辆车。

story.x: ※The 5,000 mAh battery is included in the Pro Rewards only.
story.z: ※ 5,000 mAh电池仅包含在Pro Rewards中。

story.x: Pick Your Pace: Two Battery Options. Grab the 30A (2,500 mAh) battery for ultra-lightweight tasks, the ultimate compact choice for quick jobs and effortless portability.
story.z: 选择您的节奏：两个电池选项。抓住30A （ 2,500 mAh ）电池进行超轻量化任务，这是快速工作和轻松便携的终极紧凑选择。
